works.title: EXPLORING LEARNING GAPS AND SUPPORT NEEDS IN DIFFERENTIATION AND INTEGRATION TOPIC
works.abstract: The purpose of this research was to explore any learning difficulties faced by students enrolled in Differentiation and Integration under the course DBM20173 of Engineering Mathematics 2. The aim was to pinpoint possible reasons that affected students’ comprehension and utilization of concepts of calculus, especially for questions related to interpretation, selection of methods, visualization, and problem-solving. This was accomplished using a combination of methods, namely, pre-test results, error identification, survey from students, interview or focus group discussion and observation by lecturer. The results revealed that students experienced difficulty only with the unfamiliar and application-based questions rather than direct procedural ones. According to the pre-test results, volume of bounded regions represented the highest number of difficulties among the participants with 25 out of 30 participants (83.3%), while trigonometric, exponential and reciprocal integration involved 24 students (80.0%) and area under a curve involved 23 students (76.7%). As many as 248 errors occurred during the process; formula error was found to be the most common type of errors occurring in 58 cases (23.4%), while visualisation error occurred in 43 cases (17.3%), followed by method-selection error with 42 occurrences (16.9%). The questionnaire results revealed that the level of readiness to engage in digital and immersive learning assistance was very high, as the mean score equaled 4.39, while need for visualisation and application-based assistance was also very high (mean score 4.34).
works.source_name: MALAYSIAN JOURNAL OF INNOVATION IN ENGINEERING AND APPLIED SOCIAL SCIENCES (MYJIEAS)

works.abstract: Der Beitrag beschreibt, wie die Wahrscheinlichkeits-Box von Gudrun Häring und Silke Ruwisch (2024) auch für Lernende mit intellektueller Beeinträchtigung diagnostisch genutzt werden kann. openalex_chat.answer:
## 统计口径与筛选条件

- 数据源：OpenAlex 真实论文元数据。
- 指标说明：OpenAlex 模式下 `heat` 表示论文数量，不是浏览、点赞或用户热度。
- 统计周期：最近 365 天。
- 筛选领域：`education`。
- 匹配主题：**数学教育与教学法**。
- 返回类型：关联主题，`limit=10`，实际返回 4 个关联主题。
- 需要说明：本次统计结果**没有给出**分时间段热度、新增研究数、环比百分比，也没有给出具体论文标题、作者、DOI、发表时间等元数据。

## 可验证的关联主题结果

在最近 365 天、`education` 领域内，与“数学教育与教学法”匹配到的关联主题如下：

| 关联主题 | 英文名 | 共现次数 | 关系得分 |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| 数学与计算方法 | Mathematical and Computational Methods | 1 | 0.5 |
| 数学教育与课程项目 | Mathematics Education and Programs | 1 | 0.5 |
| 教育评估与教学法 | Educational Assessment and Pedagogy | 1 | 0.5 |
| 统计教育与方法论 | Statistics Education and Methodologies | 1 | 0.5 |

这些关联主题的共现次数均为 1，关系得分均为 0.5。也就是说，在当前返回结果中，它们与“数学教育与教学法”的关联强度表现相同，无法据此判断哪个方向更强或更热。

## 趋势判断

用户询问的是“研究趋势”，但当前统计结果只包含关联主题列表，不包含按月份、季度或年度分段的数据。因此无法逐段列出：

- 热度：未提供分时间段论文数量；
- 新增研究数：未提供；
- 环比百分比：未提供。

所以，**无法判断“数学教育与教学法”相关研究是上升、下降还是稳定**。当前只能确认：在最近 365 天、`education` 领域内，该主题与上述 4 个主题存在共现记录，且共现次数很低，均为 1 次。

## 结论

当前数据不足以介绍具体论文，也不足以分析研究趋势。可验证的结论仅限于：  
“数学教育与教学法”在 OpenAlex 最近 365 天、`education` 领域下，匹配到的关联主题包括数学与计算方法、数学教育与课程项目、教育评估与教学法、统计教育与方法论；但这些关联的共现次数均为 1，关系得分均为 0.5，样本量很小，不能据此推断研究热点强弱或趋势方向。趋势结论应标记为：**数据不足，无法判断上升、下降或稳定**。
